recent_posts.title: Unlocking Concurrency with Virtual Threads in Java
recent_posts.summary: Virtual threads in Java 21 revolutionize concurrency by enabling applications to handle thousands of concurrent tasks with minimal overhead. Unlike traditional platform threads that are heavyweight and limited by OS resources, virtual threads are JVM-managed, lightweight, and stored on the heap. They eliminate the complexity of reactive programming while providing superior performance for I/O-bound operations. The article demonstrates through code examples how virtual threads can reduce execution time from 5 seconds to 1 second for the same workload, making them ideal for web applications, microservices, and database-driven systems that require high concurrency without sacrificing code simplicity.

recent_posts.title: The Rise of Agentic AI: Understanding the Evolution from Buzzwords to Autonomous Multi Agentic Systems
recent_posts.summary: Agentic AI represents an evolution from simple AI workflows to autonomous systems capable of reasoning, planning, and acting independently. Unlike traditional AI workflows where humans make decisions, AI agents can autonomously handle complex tasks by connecting to various tools and services. Single specialized agents have limited scope, leading to the need for multi-agent systems with orchestrator agents that coordinate specialized agents. Various architectural patterns exist including functional decomposition with central orchestrators, hierarchical structures, blackboard architecture, contract-based systems, and cognitive architecture inspired by human cognition.

recent_posts.title: Event-Driven Architecture: How Enterprises Manage Billions of Events
recent_posts.summary: Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) is a software design pattern gaining popularity for managing Big Data, microservices, and real-time processing. EDA decouples services, enhancing scalability, resilience, and efficiency. It facilitates asynchronous communication through events, enabling systems to handle real-time data effectively. The post covers the benefits of EDA, its key components, real-world applications in companies like Sysco and Uber, and compares EDA with service mesh architecture. It also highlights the scalability, flexibility, and potential challenges of implementing EDA.

recent_posts.title: A Data-Driven Journey into Agile Team Morale: Exploring Measurement Techniques and Research Insights.
recent_posts.summary: Agile methodologies focus on the human element of teamwork, emphasizing individuals and interactions over processes and tools. Traditional metrics like velocity and committed vs. completed story points provide insights into productivity but don't address team morale. The Team Morale Index offers a more comprehensive understanding by considering emotional states, motivation, and cohesion. Methods to measure morale include questionnaires rated on a scale, with applications like Google Forms and Microsoft Power Automate facilitating the process. Analyzing these metrics can help improve team well-being and productivity.

recent_posts.title: Using Ontologies & Scene Graphs for Advanced Image Searching
recent_posts.summary: Advanced image searching can be achieved with the use of ontologies and scene graphs. Ontologies are formal representations of knowledge that help define and organize concepts related to images, making it easier to search, filter, and retrieve images based on their content, context, and meaning. Scene graphs, on the other hand, capture the spatial and hierarchical relationships between objects in an image, providing a detailed breakdown of the objects and enhancing computer vision tasks. The combination of ontologies and scene graphs can enhance the interpretation of images for various applications in computer vision and image processing.

top_posts.summary: State management refers to managing the data and application state of a software application.
